name: Trellis
author: Erin Carter
description: An orthogonal grid of glowing conduits with a bright pad lit at every junction, like a printed circuit board carrying charge along its traces. The current runs the nearer axis of each crossing so the whole lattice reads as one routed network over a softly lit ground.

params.label: Cell size
params.effect: Size of each grid cell in CSS pixels - a fine dense circuit at the minimum, broad open routing at the maximum.

params.label: Trace weight
params.effect: Core thickness of each glowing trace in CSS pixels, from a hairline route to a fat neon bus.

params.label: Flow speed
params.effect: Speed of the charge running the traces; 0 freezes the light at the pads, high sends it coursing across the board.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Strength of the soft halo around traces and pads; low is a crisp drawn board, high a luminous bloom.
